reasons: Intentional violation used as a test fixture.

terms.meaning: code whose result depends only on its inputs and does not touch files, network or the clock.

sections.name: File setup, read
sections.title: Bad engine file read
sections.what: Exports a function that reads a file from disk, which the engine must not do.
sections.why: The code comment states it is a deliberate violation.
sections.watch_out: Engine code should not read files; this sample shows what the checker must reject.

summary: A deliberately bad engine file that reads from the disk, used to check that the architecture test flags it.
purpose: Provides a known violation of the rule that the engine must stay pure.
why: The code comment says it is deliberately bad: the pure engine importing file input and output.
how: Imports the file-reading function and exports a function that reads text from a path.
risks: Not part of the app. Copying this pattern would make engine code depend on the disk.
debug: If the architecture test stops catching this, check the engine rule and its expected message.
